scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible byte chunks.

summary.scope: Publish the complete original330-macro history, independent force/global-field audits and native replays.

independent_force_control_audit.scope: Independently reconstruct original-prefix controls, ground contact and full dynamic balances.
independent_force_control_audit.limitations: This checks only the declared original-history prefix, with real ground support and original controls. Complete grasp/lift, spatial/contact/geometry/time convergence, matching rigid feedback and native model/accuracy-cost acceptance remain incomplete. Source native contacts are preintegration while macro states are postintegration; reported same-macro state differences are physical diagnostics, not contact-law equivalence.

all_state_global_fields.scope: Audit every original-history global stress bound and prepare objective resolved-load replays.
all_state_global_fields.limitations: Every saved physical state keeps its global unaveraged nonlinear peak interval and reference hotspot position. Whole-volume Bernstein determinant/numerator bounds use saved wide coordinates; rounded FP64 field bounds and corner rounding differences are separate diagnostics. Computed-field bounds do not measure continuum error. Linear replay uses a consistent-mass fitted material frame; full-inertia versus rigid-relief differences are declared model diagnostics, not native numerical errors or matched rigid/deformable feedback. Only the audited source history is covered. Physical spatial/contact/geometry/time convergence, remaining finite-footprint models and verified warmed costs remain required.

actual_native_replays.scope: Replay independently audited original-history loads through native Quadrants recovery.
actual_native_replays.limitations: This checks the actual native production solve on objective resolved nodal loads at explicit original-history times. Full-inertia and rigid-relief inputs are separate declared problems. It does not establish finite-footprint load-model accuracy, matching rigid/deformable feedback, physical spatial/contact/time convergence or a verified warmed accuracy/cost range.

independent_interior_corner_checks.scope: Check wide whole-volume certificates against independent interior barycentric stress samples.
independent_interior_corner_checks.limitations: Barycentric samples independently check the stored Bernstein certificates; sampling alone is not a whole-volume maximum proof. The certificate follows the affine-F determinant and quadratic deviatoric Kirchhoff Bernstein construction. The explicit long-double stress cancellation allowance is recorded separately. This validates computed fields, not continuum/contact accuracy or complete application history.

limitations: All330 original macro controls and2640 physical states through3.3s, real initial geometry/ground support and unchanged1e-9 body/actual-robot gates are preserved. Recorded artificial solver stages are not physical time steps. Completion follows gapless state counts, matching protocol and independent audits, not legacy prefix labels or wrapper code. Fourteen native nodal replays isolate elastic algebra at seven times under two declared inertia inputs. Full global raw intervals remain intact; interior samples check the independent Bernstein certificates and are not a sampling-only maximum proof. This is one480-tet reference and does not establish physical spatial/contact/geometry/time convergence, finite-footprint model accuracy, matching rigid/deformable feedback or verified warmed cost. Files of at least50MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original file exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
